veg.make_ahead: Onions up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Brush the vegetarian sausages with half the oil and grill over medium coals or a barbecue, turning often, until browned and hot through.
Fry the onions in the rest of the oil until soft and sweet.
Grill the corn and brush with butter.
Serve the sausages in the rolls with the onions, mustard and tomato sauce.
Boil the whole cauliflowers in salted water for 8 minutes, then drain well.
Mix the garlic, cumin, cinnamon, salt and oil and rub all over the cauliflowers.
Sit them in a deep dish with the stock and roast at 200C, basting twice, until charred and tender to a knife.
Toast the almonds in a dry pan.
Cook the basmati with the saffron.
Cut the cauliflowers into thick wedges, pile over the rice with the pan juices, scatter with almonds and serve with the yoghurt.
Dice the mushrooms and onion. Drain the beans.
Fry the mushrooms and onion in the oil in a heavy pot until dark golden, then stir in the soy sauce.
Add the beans, tomatoes, molasses, mustard, paprika and water and simmer until thick.
For the cornbread, mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, buttermilk, egg and melted butter.
Pour into a hot buttered pan and bake at 220C.

veg.n: Bucho's tacos al pastor with oyster mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: fresh pineapple, plus extra to serve

steps.text: Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with achiote, pineapple and vinegar.
Coat the mushrooms in the marinade.
Marinate in the fridge for at least 4 hours.
Spread on an oiled tray, drizzle with the oil and roast at 220C until caramelised at the edges.
Crisp the mushrooms in batches in a hot pan.
Serve in the tortillas with pineapple, white onion and coriander.

veg.n: "As fast as a leopard" nut roast
veg.make_ahead: Shape the roast up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Fry the onion, crushed garlic, mushrooms and chopped rosemary in half the oil until dry and golden.
Mix with the nuts, lentils, breadcrumbs, cheddar and eggs and press into a lined loaf tin. Peel and cut the potatoes and pumpkin and toss in the rest of the oil.
Roast the nut roast and vegetables at 190C until the roast is firm and browned.
Rest the roast in the tin, then turn out and slice.
Cook the peas, and make gravy by cooking the flour in the roasting tray, then whisking in the stock and soy sauce.
Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the cumin and paprika.
Stir in the tomato paste, black beans and water and simmer.
Shred the lettuce, dice the tomato and grate the cheddar.
Warm the taco shells.
Set everything out with the sour cream so everyone builds their own.

veg.make_ahead: Best served hot

ingredients.item: large cauliflowers, cut into 4 thick steaks

steps.text: Season the cauliflower steaks, brown in the oil on each side, then roast at 200C until tender.
Fry the onion and apple in the pan, add the stock and mustard and reduce.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter.
Steam the green beans.
Serve the cauliflower steaks with the sauce, mash and beans.

veg.n: Fat Moe's back room braised mushrooms
veg.make_ahead: Cook up to 2 days ahead and reheat in the gravy

steps.text: Season the mushrooms and sear hard in the oil on both sides.
Spread the onions in a roasting dish and sit the mushrooms on top. Pour over the stock whisked with tomato paste, paprika and soy sauce.
Cover and braise at 170C until the onions are jammy.
Lift out the mushrooms and slice thickly.
Boil the juices for 10 minutes to make gravy and pour over.

veg.n: Pimlico match race corn and chickpea cakes
veg.make_ahead: Cakes up to 1 day ahead, fry fresh

steps.text: Roughly mash the chickpeas and mix with the corn, half the mayonnaise, egg, Dijon, soy sauce, celery salt, half the paprika, chopped parsley and panko.
Shape into cakes.
Chill for 30 minutes.
Fry in oil over medium heat until golden each side.
Bake the chips and toss with the rest of the paprika and a pinch of salt.
Toss shredded cabbage with the rest of the mayonnaise and the vinegar.
Serve with lemon wedges.
Heat the oven to 200C. Boil the cauliflowers whole for 8 minutes and drain.
Mash the butter with the zest of the lemon, 4 crushed garlic cloves, thyme leaves, salt and pepper and rub all over the cauliflowers.
Toss the potatoes and carrots in chunks with oil, salt, the rest of the garlic cloves and the halved lemon around them.
Roast 1 hour, basting the cauliflowers and turning the vegetables once.
Lift everything onto a platter. Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer 3 minutes for gravy.
Cut the cauliflowers into wedges to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 2 hours, grill fresh

steps.text: Mix the lime juice, garlic, chilli and oil and coat the haloumi. Wrap two slices in each softened banana leaf.
Grill for 8 to 10 minutes, turning once, until the haloumi is soft and golden.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with the salt. Warm the black beans.

veg.n: Charlie's lemon haloumi and Greek salad
veg.make_ahead: Haloumi can marinate up to 1 day

steps.text: Mix the haloumi with the oil, the juice of one lemon, the garlic and oregano.
Leave to marinate for 15 minutes.
Grill the haloumi until charred on both sides.
Toss the tomato, cucumber, red onion, olives and feta with the juice of the other lemon for a Greek salad.
Warm the pita and serve everything together.

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Toss the cauliflower florets with the honey, the chilli flakes, the smoked paprika, the oil and salt.
Roast at 220C for 35 minutes, turning and basting twice, until sticky and charred at the edges.
Pile onto a platter with the sticky pan juices spooned over.

veg.n: San Fransokyo ramen with glazed tofu
veg.make_ahead: Tofu can be glazed a day ahead

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry and fry in the oil until golden on both sides.
Add the soy sauce and sugar and turn the tofu until sticky.
Soft-boil the eggs.
Whisk the miso into the hot stock for the broth and cook the noodles.
Build bowls with noodles, broth, tofu, halved eggs, nori and spring onion.

veg.n: Yu Shu Lien's steamed silken tofu

steps.text: Slice the ginger and spring onions, keeping some spring onion shredded for the top.
Slide the tofu onto a heatproof plate on the sliced ginger and spring onion.
Steam until hot through.
Pile the shredded spring onion and coriander on top.
Pour over soy, then smoking hot oil so it sizzles.

veg.n: Claus family honey mustard glazed smoked tofu

steps.text: Score the tofu slabs in a diamond pattern and push a clove into a few of the crosses.
Simmer the honey, mustard, sugar and orange juice for the glaze.
Roast the potatoes in the oil at 200C. After 20 minutes add the tofu on a lined tray and bake, brushing with glaze every so often, until sticky.
Toss the beans and broccolini in butter.
Slice the tofu thickly to serve.
Season the mushrooms well. Sear in the oil in a hot pan, pressing down, turning once.
Add the butter, garlic and thyme and baste.
Rest for a minute, then slice.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the potatoes, carrots and onion.
Layer the mushrooms, lentils, potatoes, carrots and onion in a heavy pot with thyme, salt and pepper.
Add the stock, cover and simmer until the potatoes break down and thicken it.
Serve in deep bowls.

veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms and season them
Brown in batches in the oil in a heavy casserole
Add the onion, carrots, potatoes, butter beans, stock and thyme
Cover and braise at 170C, stirring once, until the potatoes are tender
Serve with crusty bread for soaking up the stock

veg.make_ahead: Hollandaise is best fresh, keep warm up to 30 minutes

ingredients.item: eggs (3 yolks for the sauce, 8 for poaching)

steps.text: Melt 150 g of the butter.
Whisk the 3 yolks with lemon juice over a gentle simmer, then slowly pour in the melted butter until thick.
Fry the mushrooms in the rest of the butter, then wilt the spinach in the same pan.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water and toast the muffins.
Top the muffins with spinach, mushrooms and eggs, spoon over the hollandaise and finish with chives.

veg.make_ahead: Soak the night before, fry fresh

ingredients.item: large cauliflower, cut into big florets

steps.text: Soak the cauliflower in buttermilk in the fridge for at least 1 hour or overnight, which is not counted here.
Dredge the cauliflower in flour seasoned with smoked paprika and salt.
Boil the potatoes for the mash and mash with butter.
Fry the cauliflower at 170C in batches until crisp and tender.
Make a gravy by thickening the stock with flour in a saucepan.
Chop the onion and garlic.
Brown the plant-based mince with the onion and garlic in the oil.
Add the passata and oregano and simmer.
Cook the spaghetti, drain and toss with the sauce.
Serve with grated vegetarian parmesan-style cheese and basil.

veg.make_ahead: Jackfruit can be cooked 1 day ahead

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Pull the jackfruit into shreds and mix with the achiote paste, orange juice, crushed garlic and oil.
Wrap tightly in foil and roast at 180C until tender.
Slice the red onion thin and quick-pickle in lime juice with a pinch of salt.
Unwrap, roast 20 minutes more until crisp at the edges, then warm the tortillas.
Serve in tortillas with the pickled onion and habanero salsa.
Brown the potatoes in the oil.
Char the chillies and tomatillos.
Blitz with onion, garlic and cumin.
Simmer the potatoes and beans in the sauce with the stock until the potatoes are soft.
Cook the rice and serve the stew over it.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Cut the mushrooms into big chunks and peel the baby onions.
Brown the mushrooms hard in the oil in batches, dusting the last batch with smoked paprika.
Add the onions and colour lightly.
Stir in the flour and tomato paste, then add the stock, soy sauce, balsamic vinegar, thyme, bay leaves and lentils.
Cover and simmer until the onions are soft and the sauce is thick.
Peel and boil the potatoes, then mash with butter and warm milk.
Serve the braise over the mash with crusty bread.

veg.n: Tai's makeover sushi bowls with tofu

steps.text: Rinse and cook the rice, then season with the rice vinegar and sugar and cool slightly.
Fry the tofu in the vegetable oil until golden, then splash with a little of the soy sauce.
Slice the avocados and cucumber. Cook the edamame.
Mix the rest of the soy with the sesame oil.
Top bowls of rice with tofu, avocado, cucumber, edamame and pickled ginger and dress.
Mix the haloumi with the juice of two limes, the chilli and oil.
Leave to marinate.
Grill the haloumi until golden on both sides.
Cook the rice.
Build bowls of rice with haloumi, sliced avocado, corn, black beans, salsa and wedges of the last lime.

veg.n: Fred O'Hare's Hollywood loaded hot dogs (vegetarian)

steps.text: Heat the vegetarian hot dogs in simmering water, then grill until marked.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, whisk in the milk and simmer until thick, then stir in the cheddar.
Mix the corn with the relish.
Toast the buns and fill with hot dogs, cheese sauce, corn relish and tomato sauce.
Top with crispy fried onions.

veg.n: Axe Gang salt and pepper tofu

steps.text: Pat the tofu dry, cut into thick fingers and toss in the potato starch. Slice the garlic, chillies and spring onions.
Fry at 180C in batches until crisp.
Cook the rice.
Grind the Sichuan pepper with the salt. Wok-toss the tofu with the garlic, chillies, spring onion and salted pepper.
Cook the sushi rice.
Fry the tofu in the oil until golden, then glaze with the soy and most of the sugar until sticky.
Whisk the eggs with the last pinch of sugar and roll into a thin omelette in a pan.
Cook the peas. Pack each box with rice topped with peas, tofu, sliced omelette and pickled ginger.

veg.make_ahead: Chilli up to 2 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Dice the onions, keeping half for topping.
Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with half the onion, chilli powder and cumin.
Add the water and simmer until loose and saucy.
Griddle the vegetarian hot dogs and steam the buns.
Fill the buns with hot dogs and top with chilli, mustard and diced raw onion.

veg.n: Kef Bir ocean stew with haloumi and white beans
veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Soften the fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes, wine and stock.
Simmer to a rich broth, then stir in the beans and nori.
Fry the haloumi in the rest of the oil until golden and drop into the stew.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

veg_af.n: Kef Bir ocean stew with haloumi and white beans (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Soften the fennel and garlic in 2 tbsp of the oil. Add the saffron, tomatoes, vinegar and stock.
Simmer to a rich broth, then stir in the beans and nori.
Fry the haloumi in the rest of the oil until golden and drop into the stew.
Toast the bread, rub with a cut garlic clove and serve alongside.

veg.n: Erebor mushroom Wellington and Yorkshire puddings
veg.make_ahead: Wellington can be assembled up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Make the batter by whisking the flour, 4 eggs and milk and rest it. Fry the chopped mushrooms and onion in the 2 tbsp oil until dry and dark, then season.
Sear the portobellos, then lay them in a line on the pastry with the mushroom mix, roll up and brush with the last egg, beaten.
Bake at 200C until the pastry is deep golden.
Heat the oil for the tin in a muffin tin at 230C.
Pour the batter into the hot tin and bake until puffed and golden.
Make gravy by boiling the stock with the soy sauce and any mushroom juices, then slice the Wellington.

veg.n: Black Phillip's root vegetable and barley stew
veg.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches
Soften the onions, carrots, parsnips and garlic
Add the barley, stock, thyme and bay leaves
Cover and braise at 170C until the barley is tender and the stew is thick
Serve with crusty bread

veg.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Cook the onions slowly.
Add the beer, stock, lentils, thyme, bay leaves, mustard and sugar and braise at 160C.
Fry the potatoes at 140C, then again at 180C until crisp.
Serve the stew with the frites.

veg_af.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days ahead, fry the chips fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Cook the onions slowly.
Add all the mushroom stock, the malt vinegar, lentils, thyme, bay leaves, mustard and sugar and braise at 160C.
Fry the potatoes at 140C, then again at 180C until crisp.
Serve the stew with the frites.

veg.n: Diner stuffed roast pumpkin with gravy
veg.make_ahead: Rest 10 minutes before carving

steps.text: Halve the pumpkin lengthways and scoop out the seeds. Fry the mushrooms in a little of the butter, mix with the stuffing mix and 250 ml of the stock, and pack into the hollows.
Tie the halves back together, rub with the oil and roast at 190C until a knife slides through.
While it roasts, boil the potatoes and mash with most of the butter.
Make gravy by cooking the flour in the last of the butter, then whisking in the remaining stock.
Rest, slice into thick rounds and serve with cranberry sauce.

veg.make_ahead: Mushrooms can be confited up to 2 days ahead

ingredients.item: large king oyster mushrooms, halved lengthways

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms and rub with salt, thyme and crushed garlic.
Lay snugly in a dish, cover with the oil and cook slowly at 140C until very tender.
Meanwhile cut the potatoes, toss in some of the oil from the mushrooms and roast at 200C until golden.
Crisp the mushrooms cut side down in a hot pan.
Dress the salad leaves with the vinegar and a little of the oil and serve with the mushrooms and potatoes.

ingredients.item: large king oyster mushrooms, halved lengthways

steps.text: Score the cut side of the mushrooms in a criss-cross.
Melt the butter with the garlic and chopped parsley and brush over the mushrooms.
Grill cut side down, then flip and baste until golden and tender.
Whisk the juice of the lemons with the olive oil into a vinaigrette, toss the salad leaves and serve alongside.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots with the thyme.
Return the mushrooms, add the beans, ale, stock and soy sauce, cover and simmer.
Serve with crusty bread and butter.

veg_af.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Soften the onions and carrots with the thyme.
Return the mushrooms, add the beans, stock, malt vinegar and soy sauce, cover and simmer.
Serve with crusty bread and butter.

veg.n: House of Blue Leaves tofu and mushroom yakitori

steps.text: Simmer the soy, mirin, sake and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Pat the tofu dry and thread onto skewers with the mushrooms and spring onion pieces. Brush with the oil.
Cook the rice.
Grill over high heat, turning and brushing with tare.

veg_af.n: House of Blue Leaves tofu and mushroom yakitori (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Simmer the soy, apple juice, water, rice vinegar and sugar until syrupy for the tare.
Pat the tofu dry and thread onto skewers with the mushrooms and spring onion pieces. Brush with the oil.
Cook the rice.
Grill over high heat, turning and brushing with tare.

ingredients.item: large eggplants, sliced lengthways 1 cm thick

steps.text: Salt the eggplant slices and leave 5 minutes, then pat dry.
Dust in flour and fry in the oil and butter in batches until golden and soft, then set aside.
Add the wine, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.
Return the eggplant to coat.

ingredients.item: large eggplants, sliced lengthways 1 cm thick

steps.text: Salt the eggplant slices and leave 5 minutes, then pat dry.
Dust in flour and fry in the oil and butter in batches until golden and soft, then set aside.
Add the stock, vinegar, lemon juice and capers, reduce by half and swirl in the cold butter and parsley.
Return the eggplant to coat.

veg.n: Dampier sausages, mushroom steaks and potato salad (vegetarian)
veg.make_ahead: Potato salad up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Boil the potatoes until tender, cool and dress with mayonnaise and chives.
Brush the sausages and mushrooms with oil and grill over medium coals, turning, until browned.
Fry the onions on the hotplate until golden.
Serve with a stack of white bread and the potato salad.
Brush the eggplant with the oil and fry until soft and browned.
Split the rolls and spread with mustard.
Layer with eggplant, capsicum, provolone and pickles.
Press hard in a sandwich press or heavy pan with a weight on top until flat, crisp and melted.
Cut in half to serve.

veg.make_ahead: Assemble up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled; add 10 minutes to the bake

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms and eggplant in the oil with the fennel seeds, add the passata and simmer.
Cook the pasta 3 minutes short of done and drain.
Mix the ricotta with the vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, nutmeg and parsley.
Layer pasta, sauce and ricotta in a baking dish and top with mozzarella.
Bake at 200C until blistered.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and salt.
Fry the haloumi in the rest of the oil until golden on both sides.
Simmer the shallot in the wine and vinegar until a couple of tablespoons are left. Whisk in the cold butter a piece at a time over low heat.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the haloumi.
Boil the potatoes for 15 minutes, drain and crush with 2 tbsp of the olive oil and salt.
Fry the haloumi in the rest of the oil until golden on both sides.
Simmer the shallot in the stock and vinegar until a couple of tablespoons are left. Whisk in the cold butter a piece at a time over low heat.
Blanch the asparagus for 2 minutes. Plate up and spoon the sauce over the haloumi.
Brown the plant-based mince in the oil with the diced onion and the diced green capsicum for 8 minutes.
Add the crushed garlic, the tomato sauce, the soy sauce, the brown sugar, the mustard and the water and simmer 15 minutes until thick.
Toast the slider buns, add half a slice of cheddar to each base, pile on the mince and top with sliced pickles.
Spread the mushrooms, haloumi and tomatoes in a big roasting tray and dot with garlic butter.
Roast at 220C until the mushrooms are golden and the tomatoes burst.
Squeeze over lemon and serve with crusty bread.
Rinse the rice and cook it, then keep warm.
Stir-fry the tofu with the garlic and chilli in half the oil in a hot wok until golden.
Add the soy sauce, mushroom oyster sauce and sugar, then toss through the Thai basil.
Fry the eggs in the rest of the oil until the edges are crisp.
Serve the tofu over rice with a fried egg on top.
Heat the oven to its highest setting with a steel or tray inside.
Stretch the dough into two thin bases.
Spread with pizza sauce and top with the mozzarella, mushrooms, capsicum and olives.
Bake until the crust is blistered and the cheese is bubbling.
Cut into squares for the whole family.

veg.n: Ravager barbecue jackfruit with corn and slaw
veg.make_ahead: Jackfruit can be baked a day ahead, glaze to serve

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Pull the jackfruit into shreds and toss with the oil, paprika and sugar.
Spread on a lined tray and bake at 200C until browned at the edges.
Stir through the barbecue sauce and glaze under the grill.
Grill the corn until charred.
Toss the slaw mix with mayonnaise and serve with the jackfruit in the rolls.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Slice the onion and sausages and dice the potatoes. Shred the cabbage.
Fry the onion in a big pot, add the sausages and smoked paprika and brown.
Add the potatoes, cabbage, caraway and stock. Simmer until the potatoes are soft and the stew is thick.
Serve with crusty bread.
Fry the tofu in the oil until crisp at the edges, then toss with the paprika, pepper and coriander.
Spread the rye slices with mustard and fill four of them with the tofu and Swiss cheese. Close the sandwiches.
Toast in a pan with the butter over medium heat until the cheese melts, turning once.
Cut on the diagonal and serve with pickles.

veg.make_ahead: Stew up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Dice the onion and pumpkin.
Soften the onion in the olive oil.
Add the pumpkin, corn, both beans, tomatoes, stock and paprika.
Simmer until thick and the pumpkin is tender.
Mix the cornmeal, flour, baking powder, egg, milk and vegetable oil into a batter.
Pour into a greased tin and bake at 200C until golden.
Serve the stew with slices of cornbread.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Chop the mushrooms and vegetables.
Brown the mushrooms in batches in the oil in a heavy pot.
Add the onion, carrots, parsnips, lentils, thyme and enough stock to cover.
Cover and simmer gently until the vegetables are tender.
Season and serve in bowls with crusty bread and butter.

veg.n: Blake's Gotham mushroom and ricotta meatball hero
veg.make_ahead: Meatballs and sauce up to 2 days

steps.text: Fry the mushrooms in 1 tbsp of the oil until dry, cool, then mix with the ricotta, egg, breadcrumbs, vegetarian parmesan-style cheese, one garlic clove and salt and roll into sixteen balls.
Brown gently in the rest of the olive oil.
Add the passata, remaining garlic and a few basil leaves and simmer.
Split and toast the rolls.
Fill with meatballs and sauce, lay provolone over and grill until melted. Finish with fresh basil.
Dust the portobello slices in the seasoned flour and sear in the butter and oil until golden, then set aside.
Brown the button mushrooms in the same pan, add the marsala and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the portobellos and warm through for a minute.
Serve with crusty bread.
Dust the portobello slices in the seasoned flour and sear in the butter and oil until golden, then set aside.
Brown the button mushrooms in the same pan, add the grape juice, balsamic vinegar and stock and reduce by half.
Whisk in the cold butter, return the portobellos and warm through for a minute.
Serve with crusty bread.
Boil the cauliflower whole for 8 minutes, drain and rub with 1 tbsp of the oil and the paprika.
Roast the potatoes with the rest of the oil and the cauliflower at 200C until golden and a knife slides into the cauliflower.
Reduce the stock with the soy sauce to a sauce and whisk in some of the butter.
Steam the beans and toss in the rest of the butter.

veg.n: Paris bistro mushrooms and white beans
veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat gently

steps.text: Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches, then add the shallot.
Pour in the wine and stock, add the beans and simmer.
Boil the potatoes, mash with butter and milk.
Stir the cream into the mushrooms, season and serve over the mash.

veg_af.n: Paris bistro mushrooms and white beans (alcohol-free)

steps.text: Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches, then add the shallot.
Pour in the stock and vinegar, add the beans and simmer.
Boil the potatoes, mash with butter and milk.
Stir the cream into the mushrooms, season and serve over the mash.

veg.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheat covered

steps.text: Cut the kumara, pumpkin and potatoes into chunks and toss with the cauliflower, chickpeas, oil, salt and paprika.
Line a deep roasting tin with cabbage leaves and add the vegetables. Cover with more cabbage and wrap tightly in foil.
Roast at 180C until everything is soft and smoky.
Unwrap and serve the vegetables with the softened cabbage.

veg.make_ahead: Better made the day before

steps.text: Brown the plant-based mince and mushrooms in the oil in batches.
Add the chopped onion, chilli powder and cumin, then the tomatoes.
Simmer gently, covered.
Add the drained kidney beans for the last stretch.
Serve with sour cream and grated cheddar.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, slice the sausages and brown them in the oil in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the wine and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated vegetarian parmesan-style cheese.
Boil the rigatoni in salted water until just tender, then drain.
Meanwhile, slice the sausages and brown them in the oil in a large pan.
Add the sliced fennel and crushed garlic and cook until soft.
Pour in the stock and lemon juice and let it bubble down, then stir in the cream.
Toss the rigatoni through the sauce with the grated vegetarian parmesan-style cheese.

veg.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Score the cut side of the eggplants, brush with the oil and roast cut side up at 220C until soft. Cook the sushi rice at the same time.
Mix the miso and honey, brush over the eggplants and grill until glazed and bubbling.
Serve the eggplant over rice with edamame, avocado and pickled ginger.
Rub the cauliflowers with the oil, garlic, rosemary, smoked paprika and salt.
Roast covered at 200C for 30 minutes, then uncover and roast until charred and tender.
Chop the tomatoes and slice the red onion for the salad.
Warm the flatbreads.
Pull the cauliflowers into chunks and serve with the flatbreads, Greek yoghurt and tomato salad.

veg.n: Prison canteen mushroom and leek pie
veg.make_ahead: Filling up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Soften the sliced leeks and mushrooms in most of the butter until golden.
Stir in the flour, then the stock, cream, Dijon, thyme and butter beans and simmer until thick.
Cool, tip into a pie dish, top with puff pastry and brush with egg.
Bake at 200C until golden.
Toss the peas in the remaining butter and serve alongside.

veg.n: Peppercorn portobello steak with roast potatoes
veg.make_ahead: Sauce up to 1 day, cook mushrooms fresh

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chunks, toss in 2 tbsp of the oil and roast at 220C until crisp.
Sear the mushrooms in the rest of the oil, pressing down, until tender, and rest.
Toast the cracked peppercorns in the pan, add the cream and simmer until thick.
Steam the asparagus and toss with butter.
Serve on white plates.
Peel the potatoes and halve the mushrooms.
Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches with the smoked paprika.
Pour in the red grape juice and stock, add the butter beans and simmer until glossy.
Boil and mash the potatoes with butter.

veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Mix the lime and orange juice with the oil, crushed garlic and cumin and coat the mushrooms.
Marinate for 30 minutes.
Cook the rice and warm the beans.
Chop the tomatoes and onion for a fresh salsa.
Grill the mushrooms over very high heat for 4 minutes a side.
Slice thickly and serve with the rice, beans and salsa.

ingredients.item: tins young green jackfruit in brine (400 g each), drained

steps.text: Bake the chips at 220C until crisp.
Meanwhile shred the jackfruit and fry in a hot pan until browned, then toss with the barbecue sauce. Tear the mozzarella.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour, then whisk in the stock and soy sauce and simmer until bubbling and thick.
Pile the chips into bowls with the jackfruit, scatter over the mozzarella and pour the hot gravy over so the cheese goes melty.
